question: What are the ids and makers of all car makers that produce at least 2 models and make more than 3 cars?
gold_query: SELECT T1.Id ,  T1.Maker FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.Maker GROUP BY T1.Id HAVING count(*)  >=  2 INTERSECT SELECT T1.Id ,  T1.Maker FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.Maker JOIN CAR_NAMES AS T3 ON T2.model  =  T3.model GROUP BY T1.Id HAVING count(*)  >  3;

steps.raw_response: {"sql": "SELECT car_makers.Id, car_makers.Maker FROM car_makers JOIN model_list ON model_list.Maker = car_makers.Id JOIN car_names ON car_names.Model = model_list.Model GROUP BY car_makers.Id, car_makers.Maker HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT model_list.ModelId) >= 2 AND COUNT(car_names.MakeId) > 3"}

final_sql: SELECT car_makers.Id, car_makers.Maker FROM car_makers JOIN model_list ON model_list.Maker = car_makers.Id JOIN car_names ON car_names.Model = model_list.Model GROUP BY car_makers.Id, car_makers.Maker HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT model_list.ModelId) >= 2 AND COUNT(car_names.MakeId) > 3
